import csv,json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
base=Path('tests/figures/upl_c08_fsmask_r1')
out=Path(str(base)+'_readable.png')
assert not out.exists()
rows=list(csv.DictReader(base.with_suffix('.csv').open(newline='',encoding='utf-8')))
assert len(rows)==5000
summary=json.loads(base.with_suffix('.check.json').read_text())['regions_and_masks']['all']
x=np.array([float(r['x_m']) for r in rows]);z=np.array([float(r['z_m']) for r in rows]);cur=np.array([int(r['current_FS2_or_3']) for r in rows],bool)
variants=('soil_self','soil_no_self','soil_wall_self','soil_wall_no_self')
colors=ListedColormap(['#d2d2d2','#149065','#db8c24','#296ea6'])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,9),sharex=True,sharey=True)
for n,(ax,var) in enumerate(zip(axes.flat,variants)):
 m=np.array([int(r['Eq68_'+var]) for r in rows],bool);labels=np.where(m,np.where(cur,1,2),np.where(cur,3,0));c=summary[var]
 ax.scatter(x,z,c=labels,cmap=colors,vmin=-.5,vmax=3.5,s=5,marker='s',linewidths=0)
 ax.set(xlim=(-.02,4.02),ylim=(-.02,2.02),aspect='equal',ylabel='z [m]')
 if n>=2:ax.set_xlabel('x [m]')
 ax.set_title(var.replace('_',' ')+f": Eq68={c['Eq68_count']}, current={cur.sum()}\nEq68 only={c['Eq68_only']}; current only={c['current_only']}",fontsize=11,pad=11)
handles=[Line2D([],[],color=colors(n),marker='s',linestyle='',label=t) for n,t in enumerate(['Both interior','Both surface','Eq68 only','Current only'])]
fig.legend(handles=handles,loc='lower center',bbox_to_anchor=(.5,.02),ncol=4,frameon=False)
fig.suptitle('C08 initial frame: Eq68 sum(Vj W_ij)<0.95 vs native FS2/3\nWall and self definitions retained separately; no tuned threshold',fontsize=14,y=.97)
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.06,right=.98,bottom=.12,top=.85,wspace=.16,hspace=.35)
fig.savefig(out,dpi=180);plt.close(fig)
print(json.dumps({'plot_only':True,'CSV_rows':len(rows),'output':str(out),'original_PNG_preserved':True,'numerical_reanalysis':False}))
